decisions.reason: Citizens Advice is public non-competitor market-context evidence, so public_dataset plus manual_research is the closest permitted existing taxonomy mapping.
The Which? member survey is public secondary consumer research, appropriately mapped to public_dataset plus manual_research.
ICO guidance defines the compliance boundary for service and marketing messages, so public_dataset plus risk_finding is appropriate.
Fergus documentation verifies an existing competitor quotation-reminder feature, so public_competitor plus competitor_check is appropriate.
ServiceM8 documentation verifies existing competitor follow-up automation and stopping conditions.
Powered Now documentation verifies existing competitor quotation-chasing capability.
Jobber documentation verifies existing competitor quotation follow-up, approval and deposit workflows.
Xero documentation verifies existing competitor quotation acceptance and status-tracking functionality.
The IET forum record is weak public qualitative research rather than first-party validation, so public_dataset plus manual_research is the closest permitted mapping.
